Equipment:Circulate Water 
 Pump
 Single Stage Vertical Pump
 Bergeron Rateau - France

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the above titled block.

This pump transfers the condensate from the hot well of 
condenser to the heaters then to feed tank.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 10 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta 3x135MW Combined Cycle PS Head 
Sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.

items:
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing suction and delivery 
 valves.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.

Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the 
 setting values, then analyze it and determine what to do [if it is needed].

Check discharge, pressure and compare it with the setting 
 values then replace the worn-out components [if it is needed].
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it [if it is needed].
Grease the bearings of the pump.
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.
Check the leakage from the glands and flanges and treat it.

Check the pump casing against rust and re -paint [if it is 
 required].

Equipment:Circulate Water

 Bergeron Rateau - France
Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the above titled block.
This pump transfers the condensate from the hot well of 
condenser to the heaters then to feed tank.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 10 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta 3x135MW Combined Cycle PS Head 
Sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing suction and delivery 
 valves.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Filler, Vibrometer,
Dial indicator, Rags, Grease.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in operation
Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the 
 setting values, then analyze it and determine what to do [if it is needed].
Check discharge, pressure and compare it with the setting 
 values then replace the worn-out components [if it is needed].
Pump out of operation
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it [if it is needed].
Grease the bearings of the pump.
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.
Check the leakage from the glands and flanges and treat it.
Check the pump casing against rust and re -paint [if it is 
 required].
